<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .

# Shape representing the regulatory definition of a Category A ship
# Source: IMO‑001 “2.1 Category A ship means a ship designed for operation in polar waters in at least medium first‑year ice, which may include old ice inclusions.”
# The admission declares the complete synthetic population of nltl:ship instances.

:CategoryAShipShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;
    rdfs:label "Category A ship shape" ;
    rdfs:comment "Enforces that a ship classified as Category A has the required design ice condition per IMO‑001 §2.1." ;
    
    # Ship must be assigned the Category A value
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:shipCategory ;
        sh:hasValue nltl:polarShipCategoryA ;
        sh:severity sh:Info ;
        sh:message "Ship is classified as Category A (polarShipCategoryA)." ;
    ] ;
    
    # Design ice condition must be at least medium first‑year ice with possible old‑ice inclusions
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:designIceCondition ;
        sh:hasValue nltl:mediumFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions ;
        sh:severity sh:Violation ;
        sh:message "Category A ship must be designed for operation in at least medium first‑year ice (may include old ice inclusions)." ;
    ] .
<END_SHACL>

We need to produce SHACL graph implementing the regulatory source: IMO-001 clause 2.1: definition of Category A ship: "Category A ship means a ship designed for operation in polar waters in at least medium first-year ice, which may include old ice inclusions."

We have ontology terms: shipCategory (object property), polarShipCategoryA (named individual of polarShipCategoryValue), designIceCondition (object property) linking ship to iceConditionValue, and we have specific ice condition value individuals: mediumFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions.

We need to encode constraint that for ships, if shipCategory = polarShipCategoryA then designIceCondition must be mediumFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions? Actually definition: Category A ship means a ship designed for operation in polar waters in at least medium first-year ice, which may include old ice inclusions. So the category is defined by designIceCondition being at least medium first-year ice (including old). The individuals: mediumFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions captures that. So SHACL shape should enforce that any ship that has shipCategory polarShipCategoryA must have designIceCondition value exactly that individual? "At least" maybe not exactly but we have no "at least" semantics; use exact in SHACL.

We need a SHACL shape targeting ships (class https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#ship) from admission. Use sh:targetClass. Provide property shapes: shipCategory must have value polarShipCategoryA (maybe sh:hasValue). Actually we want to tie category to ice condition. Could make a rule: if shipCategory = polarShipCategoryA then designIceCondition must be mediumFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions. Use sh:if and sh:then? SHACL supports sh:property with sh:qualifiedValueShape? Might use sh:property with sh:path shipCategory, sh:hasValue polarShipCategoryA but also need implication. Could use sh:nodeKind and sh:class.

Simpler: create a shape for Category A ships: shape targeting ships that have shipCategory polarShipCategoryA (using sh:property with sh:hasValue). Then another property shape enforce designIceCondition exactly mediumFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions.

We need to include source evidence via sh:message maybe? but not needed.

Include prefixes: sh, rdf, rdfs, xsd, nltl (the ontology namespace). Use exact IRIs.

Also need to include quantityEncoding: not relevant.

We must not invent selectors; target class is ship. That's allowed because admission includes ship population.

Include shape name: :CategoryAShipShape.

Add sh:targetClass nltl:ship.

Add sh:property [ sh:path nltl:shipCategory ; sh:hasValue nltl:polarShipCategoryA ; sh:severity sh:Info ; sh:message "Ship classified as Category A." ].

And also property shape for designIceCondition: sh:path nltl:designIceCondition ; sh:hasValue nltl:mediumFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions ; sh:severity sh:Violation ; sh:message "Category A ship must be designed for at least medium first-year ice with possible old ice inclusions.".

Add comment with source citation.

Everything in Turtle.

Make sure to include prefix declarations. Also include <BEGIN_SHACL> and <END_SHACL> lines.

No extra invented concepts.
